definitions.explanation: A person who oversees and manages the production of a film, television program, music recording, or other creative work. Responsible for budgeting, scheduling, and overall project management.

examples.japanese: プロデューサー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was appointed as the producer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プロデューサー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a meeting with the program's producer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧なプロデューサー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}がけた→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Films produced by famous producers always generate buzz.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated to P (ピー) in industry slang, as in ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧P (executive producer). In Japanese TV, the プロデューサー has a higher position than the ⟦ディレクター→ディレクター：12834_direkutaa⟧, overseeing the entire project including budget and staffing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧プロデューサー: music producer
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧プロデューサー: film producer
- エグゼクティブプロデューサー: executive producer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ディレクター→ディレクター：12834_direkutaa⟧: director (handles on-site direction)
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧: director (film/sports context)
